summary: Best 32.814 (r3b3_gw eval 6,238M, CP2): the greedy line flies the human's whole CP2 sequence and works on a kill-wrapped block past CP2. Concentrating the greedy-line spawns at the block (30% of non-start rows, 2..0.25 s before each greedy death) moved the training ceiling 32,177 -> 33,096 u (33.85%) in ~230M steps. Key findings: (1) the 0.5/s time penalty priced the slow CP2 detour and the cavity dip below an early death; --time-pen 0 --surf-bonus 0 freed a pit-locked checkpoint within 25M steps (28.2 -> 30.35 -> 32.5); (2) without it the line holds at T 0.4-1.3, breaks above 1.5, and at T 1 cannot even reach the block -> T cap 0.5. New code: --respawn-greedy, --int-real-only, --sil-tempered, --sil-top.
